coordinate_space: metres, camera forward/right/up; elbow offsets relative to NaturalAimV3
cycle_contract: One left-right stride, evaluated with the existing footstep distance phase. Continuous periodic motion, no ease-to-zero at intermediate keys.

stroke_wave.derivation: First two Fourier harmonics of the V4 stroke, normalized to its original -1..1 excursion. Removes intermediate dwell and acceleration discontinuities.

intent: Retain V4 carry heights, angles, grip and elbow-led alternating strokes. Smooth the continuous gait, halve landing bounce, and retain original arm lengths and wrist relationship.
